fullContentHtml:
DRDO CEPTAM-11 Tier-II Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO CEPTAM) has released the Tier-II Answer Key for the recruitment of Senior Technical Assistant-B, Technician-A Posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 764 posts. Applications for the DRDO CEPTAM-11 Recruitment 2026 were accepted from December 11, 2025, to January 11, 2026. The Tier-II examination was held 15 June 2026. Candidates who had appeared in Tier-II Examination can download their DRDO CEPTAM-11 Tier-II Answer Key 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 11 December 2025
  • Last Date : 11 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 13 January 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 14-16 January 2026
  • Exam Date : 23 March 2026
  • Exam City Details : 13 March 2026
  • Admit Card : 20 March 2026
  • Answer Key : 25 March 2026
  • Tier-I Result : 25 May 2026
  • Tier-II Exam Date : 15 June 2026
  • Tier-II Admit Card : 15 June 2026
  • Tier-II Answer Key : 18 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS, MSP : Rs. 750/- (For STA Post)
  • General, OBC, EWS, MSP : Rs. 600/- (For Tech. A Post)
  • SC, ST, PH, ESM, All Female : Rs. 500/- (For Both Posts) Fees Refund (After Tier-I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS, MSP : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH, All Female : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
